decisions.question: Supply the exported workflow YAML to repair. The working directory contained no .yaml/.yml/.zip file and no manifest; nothing could be parsed, validated or repaired.

Confirm the intended approval process (approver per step, rejection outcomes, return targets) so the repair can be checked against it. Without the export or a design, the process is unknown and must not be reconstructed from assumptions.
Provide the destination group ids (receipts) for every approver/assignee, or accept a draft whose assignees are omitted and listed in setup.md. Fabricated UUIDs will not be written.
Either authorize the Provia connector (org_get_context / workflow_export_yaml were offered by the host but the call was not permitted in this session) or paste/attach the export manually.
Confirm country and language for the repaired package. Angola / en were used provisionally because none was supplied.
